method: Python -B import frozen FullLogMonitor (markers default empty), point at each unchanged historical serial.log; one full-file poll then 20 empty polls and four ready-regex scans. Measured via perf_counter. No VM/service/browser, no source edits. Measurements recorded from completed exec session 60580.
scope: Single host-only replay per historical log, not real streaming or production full marker configuration. No CPU/IO attribution or causal root-fix inference. Ready scans run unconditionally here, whereas real runner gates three of them.
finding: Retained text only 2.8-4.4K characters in these short runs; repeat retained-text scanning is not demonstrated to be a material startup bottleneck. Whole-log initial parse ~2.3-2.5s must not be added to each incremental real poll. No optimization to production logger justified by this benchmark alone.
